[[Kyoto Sanga FC|Sanga]] vs. [[JEF United Chiba|JEF United]]) | average attendance = 18,985 | prevseason = [[2008 J.League Division 1|2008]] | nextseason = [[2010 J.League Division 1|2010]] }} The '''2009 J.League Division 1''' season was the 45th season of the top-flight club football in Japan and the 17th season since the establishment of [[J1 League|J.League Division 1]]. The season started on March 7 and ended on December, 5. A total of eighteen clubs participated in double round-robin format. At the end of the season, top three clubs received automatic qualification to the following years' [[AFC Champions League Elite|AFC Champions League]]. Also starting this season, the bottom three clubs were relegated to [[J2 League|J.League Division 2]] by default. Marinos]] | | | | {{flagicon|South Korea}} [[Kim Kun-hoan]] | | {{flagicon|South Korea}} [[Jeong Dong-ho]] | |} == League format == Eighteen clubs will play in double round-robin (home and away) format, a total of 34 games each. A club receives 3 points for a win, 1 point for a tie, and 0 points for a loss. The clubs are ranked by points, and tie breakers are, in the following order: * Goal differential * Goals scored * Head-to-head results * Disciplinary points A draw would be conducted, if necessary. However, if two clubs are tied at the first place, both clubs will be declared as the champions. The bottom three clubs will be relegated to [[J2 League]]. The top three clubs will qualify to [[AFC Champions League]] in the following year. ;Changes from previous year * Bottom three clubs are relegated by default; during 2004–2008 season, the 16th-place club needed to win [[J.
